summary: Faz 5 License system tested end-to-end. Backend: 31/32 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_license.py. Frontend: Redeem flow, admin LicenseManagement UI, and session-kicked overlay all verified via Playwright. One legit backend bug found: /api/weather uses Depends(current_user) instead of Depends(licensed_user) — unlicensed users can still fetch weather.

minor.issue: Not license-gated; uses Depends(current_user). Per Faz 5 spec /api/weather is on the gated list. Change to Depends(licensed_user) in server.py:829. (/api/weather/search is correctly gated.)

action_items: In /app/backend/server.py line 829, change `user: dict = Depends(current_user)` to `user: dict = Depends(licensed_user)` on the `/api/weather` endpoint so unlicensed regular users are blocked (currently returns 200).
critical_code_review_comments: license_service.redeem_license: uses `secrets.choice` — good. Uniqueness retry loop is fine (10 attempts). Key alphabet correctly excludes O/0/I/1/L (uses ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789 = 31 chars, spec says 30-char alphabet but 31 is a superset that still meets the no-ambiguous-char requirement).
license_service.update_license: extend_days with a currently-null expires_at falls back to now() — behaves correctly for un-assigned keys (test confirmed).
server.py `/api/weather` endpoint is inconsistent with `/api/weather/search`: main endpoint is NOT gated while its search variant is. Simple one-line fix.

license_router.logout-others: does not carry a JWT `sid` refresh for the caller, so calling it will kick THE CALLER too on next request. Docstring hints at this but UX consideration: FE should re-login the caller after logout-others succeeds. (Not tested — endpoint not referenced in requested checks.)

SertexMain relies on axios interceptor to fire the session-kicked overlay. Overlay UI is verified working via dispatchEvent; however there is no background polling of /api/license/me, so a passive Tab A will not notice being kicked until user interacts. Consider adding a low-frequency poll (e.g., every 30-60s) so kicks are surfaced promptly.

Post-run cleanup script also revoked/deleted any leftover TEST_ keys and removed fetestuser. ahmet's original license SERTEX-G863-27XN-2EXB is untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_license.py -n 0 -v` — MUST use `-n 0` because pytest-xdist parallel workers each log in as the same user and kick each other (single-session enforcement). All test classes are order-safe when serial. The one expected failure `test_weather_main_endpoint_should_be_gated` is intentional — remove that assertion once /api/weather is switched to Depends(licensed_user). Frontend flows verified: (a) unlicensed user login → RedeemScreen → invalid key toast → valid key → main app; (b) admin Settings→Lisanslar tab renders 4 stat cards + generator + filters + rows with per-status action buttons (Askıya Al / İptal / Sil / +7g / +30g / +365g / Aktifleştir) as spec'd; (c) session-kicked overlay renders correctly via CustomEvent('sertex:session-kicked') and its YENIDEN GIRIS YAP button navigates back to login.
rca of the issue: Weather endpoint gap: server.py has TWO weather endpoints. /api/weather/search (line 811) correctly depends on licensed_user, but the main /api/weather (line 823) still depends on current_user — likely missed during the licensed_user refactor. Fix is a one-line change on line 829.
